sections.title: Supported devices
sections.body: Scanning needs an iPhone with LiDAR (iPhone 12 Pro or later) running iOS 17 or later. Other devices can open and share mirrors that are already on them.

sections.title: Scan a table
sections.body: Tap New scan and allow camera access. Walk slowly around the table and its surroundings in good light. The LiDAR mesh turns from orange to lime where Ayna already has sharp photos; photos are taken automatically, and the shutter adds a close-up. Photo detail is the share of the observed surfaces with useful photos, not the share of the room that was scanned. Tap Done whenever you like; it turns lime when the scan looks complete.

sections.title: Hero shot
sections.body: After Done, step back and frame the whole work surface. Keep the level line lime and tap the shutter. This photo is the "before" that Ayna edits into the "after". You can skip it, but the mirror then has no hero shot.

sections.title: Camera access is off
sections.body: Open About → Open app settings and enable Camera. If Camera is restricted, check Screen Time or your device-management policy. Saved mirrors stay available without camera access.

sections.title: Send to Ayna
sections.body: Open a mirror and tap Send to Ayna. The first time, open Mirrors on the Ayna website: it shows a 6-character code that works for 10 minutes. Enter it to pair this iPhone; you pair once. The app then uploads the mirror, also while it is in the background, and Ayna builds its twin, which you open on the web. If sending fails, the card says why and offers Retry. Closing Ayna from the app switcher stops an upload. Pairing with Ayna in a mirror's menu shows the account and the server, and unpairs.

sections.title: Share a mirror
sections.body: Open a mirror and tap Share .zip, then choose AirDrop, Files or another destination. The archive holds the house-capture/5 bundle: RoomPlan layout, LiDAR mesh, posed photos (including the hero shot) and depth frames. No account or receiver app is needed.

sections.title: Interrupted scans and storage
sections.body: Recording pauses when the app goes to the background or tracking becomes unreliable. Return to the area you just scanned and pan slowly; recording resumes once the position is stable. If tracking does not recover, tap Done to keep what was captured. Keep at least 500 MB free before scanning; recording pauses below 200 MB.

sections.title: Delete a mirror
sections.body: Open a mirror, tap the menu and choose Delete mirror. This removes its photos, mesh and depth from this iPhone. Copies you already shared are not affected.
